lines.en: label dormwar9:
scene frown
It’s easy to smile when you’re feeling sad, and it’s easy to frown when you’re feeling happy.
lines.zh: 难过的时候很容易笑出来，开心的时候也很容易皱起眉头。

lines.en: It’s actually rather easy to combine any two contradictory emotions and expressions if you put your mind to it.
lines.zh: 只要你用心，把任意两种矛盾的情绪和表情揉在一起，其实相当容易。

lines.en: The only issue is that our minds are so full of toxic sludge and faded photographs we call “memories,” for lack of a better term, to really give us the space we need to take control.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，我们的脑子里塞满了有毒的淤泥，还有那些褪色的、我们姑且称之为“记忆”的照片，根本没有多余的空间让我们夺回控制权。

lines.en: To dig our fingers straight through our skulls and start sloshing around beautiful brain matter as if it’s a bowl of ground beef that we’re mixing and preparing for dinner.
lines.zh: 把手指直接插进头骨，在那团美丽的脑浆里搅来搅去，就像在拌一碗准备下锅的绞肉。

lines.en: Why now?
lines.zh: 为什么是现在？

lines.en: if ayanelust15 == False:
Why, in the midst of what should be one of the happiest times I’ve had, does it suddenly feel impossible to control anything at all?
lines.zh: 为什么在我本该最幸福的时刻之一，一切却突然变得完全无法掌控？

lines.en: My hands are no strangers to meat.
lines.zh: 我这双手对肉可不陌生。

lines.en: I have done my fair share of sloshing.
lines.zh: 搅拌这种事，我也干过不少。

lines.en: else:
Is it because I watched one more petal fall off of one of the tallest sunflowers I have seen just moments ago?
lines.zh: 是因为刚才我又看见一片花瓣，从我见过最高的向日葵上落下了吗？

lines.en: Is it because even when there was a girl in my arms, crying to the point of hyperventilation, I couldn’t help but focus on an innate desire to mop my cum off the floor so it does not stain the carpet?
lines.zh: 是因为哪怕有个女孩在我怀里哭到快要过度换气，我还是忍不住只想着把地上的精液擦掉，免得弄脏地毯吗？

lines.en: You do not understand.
lines.zh: 你不懂。

lines.en: You really don’t.
lines.zh: 你是真的不懂。

lines.en: Why now?
lines.zh: 为什么是现在？

lines.en: I look in the mirror and attempt to contort my face into something unrecognizable, but what I see is no reflection of myself.
lines.zh: 我看着镜子，试着把脸扭曲成认不出的样子，可我看到的根本不是我自己的倒影。

lines.en: It’s a pair of disembodied hands, sifting through the hair of someone who does not exist.
lines.zh: 那是一双脱离了身体的手，正在梳理某个并不存在的人的头发。

lines.en: They look soft.
lines.zh: 它们看起来很柔软。

lines.en: They smell like cherry blossoms.
lines.zh: 它们闻起来像樱花。

scene handsareweird
I place my hand against the mirror and hope to feel one of the two on the other side.
lines.zh: 我把手贴在镜面上，希望能触到镜子另一边的那只手。

lines.en: Ideally, I would like to feel both.
lines.zh: 理想情况下，我希望两只都能触到。

lines.en: But I feel nothing.
lines.zh: 可我什么都感觉不到。

lines.en: I guess that isn’t much of a surprise though, considering that feeling nothing has essentially become the norm for me.
lines.zh: 不过这也没什么好意外的，毕竟“什么都感觉不到”基本上已经成了我的常态。

lines.en: But maybe one day.
lines.zh: 但也许有一天。

lines.en: Maybe one day, when either I get recycled into some other person’s body and have nothing else to do but crawl into the lives of another set of [young_girls]-
lines.zh: 也许有一天，要么我被回收进别人的身体，除了爬进另一群[young_girls]的生活里无事可做——

lines.en: Or when the world stops resetting (Doubtful, but you’d have to ask Maya)-
lines.zh: 要么这个世界停止重置（不太可能，不过这你得去问 Maya）——

lines.en: Maybe then.
lines.zh: 也许到那时吧。

lines.en: scene handsareweird2
I punch the mirror and cut my hand. Blood spills out all over the bathroom.
lines.zh: 我一拳砸在镜子上，划破了手。血洒得整个浴室都是。

lines.en: I run it under hot water for 23 seconds and discover that there is no cut and no blood.
lines.zh: 我把手放在热水下冲了 23 秒，然后发现既没有伤口，也没有血。

lines.en: There is nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都没有。

lines.en: scene black
I need to go for a walk.
lines.zh: 我得出去走走。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter1
I stumble upon Yuki after-
lines.zh: 在——之后，我偶然撞见了 Yuki。

lines.en: Actually, I’m not really sure how long I’ve been out here.
lines.zh: 其实我也不确定自己在外面待了多久。

lines.en: Ten minutes? Thirty? An hour?
lines.zh: 十分钟？三十分钟？一个小时？

lines.en: Hell, maybe I’ve gone really overboard and I’ve been aimlessly walking around this area for years, always slightly out of reach of everyone.
lines.zh: 见鬼，也许我早就过头了，已经在这一带漫无目的地走了好几年，永远差那么一点够不着任何人。

lines.en: Maybe I’m a missing person and Yuki is about to get a sweet reward.
lines.zh: 也许我已经是个失踪人口，而 Yuki 马上要领到一笔丰厚的赏金了。

lines.en: I call out to her, as today is her lucky day.
lines.zh: 我朝她喊了一声——今天是她的幸运日。

lines.en: : Yuki Yamaguchi.
lines.zh: : Yuki Yamaguchi。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter2
: Why the fuck are you using my full name all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你他妈怎么突然叫我全名？

lines.en: : Actually, the hell are you even doing around here? Not a place I’ve ever seen you before.
lines.zh: : 还有，你他妈在这儿干嘛？这地方我从没见过你出现过。

lines.en: : I’m currently chaperoning twenty girls in a battle for my body.
lines.zh: : 我现在正监护着二十个女生，她们在为我的身体打得不可开交。

lines.en: : And I’m the richest girl in fucking Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 而我他妈是 Kumon-mi 最有钱的姑娘。

lines.en: : That can’t be true because the richest girl in Kumon-mi is actually part of the twenty that-
lines.zh: : 这不可能，因为 Kumon-mi 最有钱的姑娘其实就在那二十个人里——

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter3
: If you’re gonna flirt with me, can you at least do it in like a...less fucking weird way or something? Because I have no idea what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 你要是想跟我调情，能不能至少用……不那么他妈奇怪的方式？因为我完全不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : And by the looks of it, neither do you.
lines.zh: : 而且看样子，你自己也不知道。

lines.en: : You on something right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在嗑药了？

lines.en: : Me? Not that I’m aware of.
lines.zh: : 我？据我所知没有。

lines.en: : Unless one of the other girls snuck in and-
lines.zh: : 除非哪个女生偷偷混进来——

lines.en: : Actually, how long does being roofied last?
lines.zh: : 话说，被下迷药的药效能持续多久？

lines.en: : Jesus, you’re the worst fucking chaperone in the world.
lines.zh: : 老天，你他妈是世界上最烂的监护人。

lines.en: : No, not for them. For me.
lines.zh: : 不，不是给她们下的。是给我。

lines.en: : You roofied yourself? The fuck is your problem?
lines.zh: : 你给自己下药？你他妈有什么毛病？

lines.en: : No, I just-
lines.zh: : 不，我只是——

lines.en: : Actually, forget all that. What are you doing out here?
lines.zh: : 算了，那些都不提了。你在这儿干嘛？

lines.en: : Fuck’s it look like I’m doing? I’m smoking.
lines.zh: : 看起来像在干嘛？我在抽烟。

lines.en: : Yes, but it’s also the middle of the night. Shouldn’t you be at home or something?
lines.zh: : 是，可现在是大半夜。你不是该待在家里什么的吗？

lines.en: : Mind your own fucking business. No point in asking me a question in return if you’re not even gonna answer mine.
lines.zh: : 少他妈管闲事。你要是连我的问题都不打算回答，就别反过来问我。

lines.en: : I really wasn’t kidding about the chaperone thing.
lines.zh: : 监护人那事我真没开玩笑。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure there’s like, a pillow fight or something going on as we speak.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定这会儿她们大概正在打枕头仗什么的。

lines.en: : We’re at a hotel not far from here. I think.
lines.zh: : 我们在离这儿不远的一家酒店。大概吧。

lines.en: : I may or may not be lost right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在可能迷路了，也可能没有。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter4
: You’re a weird fucking guy.
lines.zh: : 你他妈真是个怪人。

lines.en: : That is certainly one way to describe me.
lines.zh: : 这确实是形容我的一种方式。

lines.en: : What about you, then? Have I proven myself worthy enough to ask you a question in return?
lines.zh: : 那你呢？我够格反过来问你一个问题了吗？

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter5
: Since you apparently {i}have{/i} to fucking know...I’m coming back from some fuckin’ NA thing.
lines.zh: : 既然你他妈{i}非要{/i}知道……我刚从一个什么 NA 互助会回来。

lines.en: : Don’t really do shit like that often, but it’s not like I have anything else to do lately.
lines.zh: : 这种事我不常做，不过最近我也没什么别的事可干。

lines.en: : Do you...also want to chaperone twenty girls in their quest for my body?
lines.zh: : 你……也想来监护二十个追求我身体的女生吗？

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter6
: Ha! Yeah, because my track record of babysitting is one of the best around. Sure thing.
lines.zh: : 哈！行啊，毕竟我带孩子的履历在这一带可是数一数二的。没问题。

lines.en: : Yumi’s actually there, you know.
lines.zh: : 其实 Yumi 也在那儿，你知道吧。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter7
: This you finally admitting that you’re fucking my daughter?
lines.zh: : 这是你终于承认你在搞我女儿了？

lines.en: : What? No. But I guess I don’t blame you for interpreting it that way.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。不过你会这么理解，我也不怪你。

lines.en: : How else would I fuckin' interpret that?
lines.zh: : 不然我他妈该怎么理解？

lines.en: : And what do you mean Yumi’s there?
lines.zh: : 还有，你说 Yumi 在那儿是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that she is one of the twenty girls at the hotel right now.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，她现在就在酒店的二十个女生里。

lines.en: : {i}My{/i} Yumi is at a hotel with nineteen other girls? They’re not a biker gang, are they?
lines.zh: : {i}我家{/i} Yumi 跟另外十九个女生在酒店？她们该不会是个飞车党吧？

lines.en: : Do biker gangs paint each other’s nails and play truth or dare?
lines.zh: : 飞车党会互相涂指甲油、玩真心话大冒险吗？

lines.en: : Sometimes, sure. We had girls like that.
lines.zh: : 有时候会啊。我们以前就有这样的姑娘。

lines.en: : Your backstory just got a lot more interesting then.
lines.zh: : 那你的过去一下子有意思多了。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter8
: I obviously wasn’t one of ‘em. But yeah, there were definitely a bunch of girls who were into that feminine shit.
lines.zh: : 我显然不是那种人。不过没错，确实有一堆姑娘好这口女性化的玩意儿。

lines.en: : If they ain’t a fuckin’ biker gang or whatever, the hell’s goin’ on over there? It ain’t like a normal slumber party or some shit, is it?
lines.zh: : 既然她们不是什么飞车党，那那边到底在搞什么？总不会是普通的睡衣派对之类吧？

lines.en: : It kind of is.
lines.zh: : 差不多就是。

lines.en: : The second floor of their dorm just filled up, so all of the girls are holding one-on-one competitions to see who’s better at certain things.
lines.zh: : 她们宿舍二楼刚住满，所以所有女生都在进行一对一的比拼，看谁在某些事情上更厉害。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. And what’s Yumi “competing” in? Girl’s got no talent at all. Just like her mom.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。那 Yumi “比”的是什么？那丫头一点才艺都没有。跟她妈一个样。

lines.en: : Well, except for that whole business management thing she’s got goin’ on now.
lines.zh: : 好吧，除了她现在搞的那个什么商业经营。

lines.en: : She sells stolen TVs, Yuki. That’s hardly a business.
lines.zh: : 她卖的是偷来的电视，Yuki。那算不上生意。

lines.en: : She have customers?
lines.zh: : 她有客户吗？

lines.en: : Well, selling them would imply that she does. But it can’t be very many and-
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然是卖，就说明有吧。不过肯定不多，而且——

lines.en: : Well then that’s a fuckin’ business. Now tell me, what’s she up to? What’s her contest?
lines.zh: : 那就是他妈的生意。现在告诉我，她在搞什么？她的比赛是什么？

lines.en: : Yumi’s contest is...
lines.zh: : Yumi 的比赛是……

lines.en: : Well, let’s just say that all she needs to do in order to win is...cooperate.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这么说吧，她要赢只需要……配合。

lines.en: : So it’s like a fuckin’ teamwork thing or some shit?
lines.zh: : 所以是那种团队合作之类的玩意儿？

lines.en: : Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 对啊。有何不可？

lines.en: : Also, she’s up against Io.
lines.zh: : 还有，她的对手是 Io。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter9
: Wait, you pullin’ my leg right now?
lines.zh: : 等等，你在逗我玩呢？

lines.en: : Two of them aren’t friends, are they?
lines.zh: : 她俩不是朋友吧？

lines.en: : They are quite the opposite.
lines.zh: : 恰恰相反。

lines.en: : In fact, neither of them really talk to anybody other than their roommates.
lines.zh: : 事实上，她们两个除了室友以外基本不跟任何人说话。

lines.en: : Wow.
: Small fuckin’ world, huh?
lines.zh: : 这世界他妈真小啊，是吧？

lines.en: : I obviously ain’t one to brag about my daughter and shit, but if that’s all the competition is, Yumi is going to win.
lines.zh: : 我显然不是那种爱吹自己女儿的人，不过如果比赛就这点内容，那 Yumi 会赢。

lines.en: : Not a doubt in my mind.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不怀疑。

lines.en: : Why do you say that?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说？

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter10
: She ever say anything about when she was younger?
lines.zh: : 她说过她小时候的事吗？

lines.en: : Apart from all the shit about me, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，除了关于我的那些破事。

lines.en: : Not really. Yumi doesn’t open up much.
lines.zh: : 基本没有。Yumi 不太敞开心扉。

lines.en: : Course she doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 她当然不会。

lines.en: : She liked playin’ a lot when she was little.
lines.zh: : 她小时候很喜欢玩。

lines.en: : Thing is, we didn’t really live in a place where it was okay for kids to hang around, so she didn’t see too many of ‘em and always had to play by herself.
lines.zh: : 问题是，我们住的地方不太适合小孩待，所以她见不到几个同龄人，总是自己一个人玩。

lines.en: : Don’t know how much she’s changed since then, but I’d be willing to bet fucking money that she just wants to be included in something.
lines.zh: : 不知道她这些年变了多少，但我敢拿钱打赌——她只是想被拉进某个圈子里。

lines.en: : If that’s the case, she should probably stop pushing people away when they try to include her.
lines.zh: : 如果是这样，那别人想拉她进来的时候，她大概该别再把人推开。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter11
: Do you like dudes?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢男人吗？

lines.en: : ...Yuki, what the fuck?
lines.zh: : ……Yuki，你他妈在搞什么？

lines.en: : Answer honestly. I don’t have a fuckin’ problem with it if you do.
lines.zh: : 老实回答。你就算喜欢，我也他妈没意见。

lines.en: : I don't. And what does that even have to do with anything?
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢。这跟现在的事有什么关系？

lines.en: : Say that you {i}did{/i} like dudes. Just a big ole fuckin' cock jockey-
lines.zh: : 假设你{i}喜欢{/i}男人。就是个他妈的骑鸡佬——

lines.en: : Yuki, what is happening right now?
lines.zh: : Yuki，现在到底在发生什么？

lines.en: : I’m not fuckin’ finished. Hold on a sec.
lines.zh: : 我他妈还没说完。等一下。

lines.en: : Say that you {i}did{/i} actually like dudes, but everyone knew you as the womanizing daughter fucker you actually are.
lines.zh: : 假设你{i}真的{/i}喜欢男人，可所有人都把你当成那个好色之徒、专搞别人女儿的家伙。

lines.en: : Then one dude shows up to a party you’re at with a bunch of those daughters and is like, “Hey man. You down?”
lines.zh: : 然后有个男的来到你和你一堆“女儿”在的派对上，跟你说：“嘿哥们，来吗？”

lines.en: : Would you be like “Yeah, let’s go,” or would you take a look at your fuckin’ surroundings and think that it might just be better to hide who you really are?
lines.zh: : 你会说“好啊，走起”，还是环顾一下四周，觉得还是把自己真实的样子藏起来比较好？

lines.en: : Now, I’m by no means a champion of morality, but it seems a little wrong to be comparing sexual preferences to your daughter not wanting to talk to people.
lines.zh: : 我绝不是什么道德标兵，不过把性取向和你女儿不想跟人说话放在一起比，好像有点不太对。

lines.en: : Probably not “politically correct” or whatever bullshit kids are saying nowadays, but it sounds about right to me.
lines.zh: : 大概是不太“政治正确”或者现在小孩说的什么屁话，不过我觉得挺到位的。

lines.en: : Point is, sometimes people don’t take what they actually want when it’s offered to ‘em...because there’s a lot more to it than that.
lines.zh: : 重点是，有时候别人把真正想要的东西递到你面前，你却不会伸手……因为事情远不止那么简单。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to want shit, but to want shit and not care about what other people think about you isn’t somethin’ most can do.
lines.zh: : 想要是一回事，想要又不在乎别人怎么看你——大多数人做不到。

lines.en: : So, basically, Yumi won’t talk to any of the other girls because she’s already established herself as the “Girl who doesn’t talk to other girls?”
lines.zh: : 所以，基本上就是——Yumi 不跟其他女生说话，是因为她已经把自己定位成了“那个不跟女生说话的女生”？

lines.en: : Yeah. Pretty much sums up what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 对。基本就是我想说的。

lines.en: : Teenagers are fucking exhausting.
lines.zh: : 青少年真是他妈累人。

lines.en: : Is what it is, man.
lines.zh: : 就这样吧，老兄。

lines.en: : She’ll probably start comin’ out of her shell in due time if she’s anything like she used to be way back when.
lines.zh: : 要是她还有点小时候的影子，迟早会自己从壳里钻出来的。

lines.en: : As for Io...
lines.zh: : 至于 Io……

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : They’re both enigmas.
lines.zh: : 她们俩都是谜。

lines.en: : Nah. They’re just [teenager]s.
lines.zh: : 不。她们只是[teenager]而已。

lines.en: : Figured you’d have realized that by now.
lines.zh: : 我以为你早就意识到了。

lines.en: Of course I’ve realized that...
lines.zh: 我当然早就意识到了……

lines.en: In fact, pretty much everything Yuki said is something I’ve already filtered through the sloshy brain meat inside of my skull.
lines.zh: 事实上，Yuki 说的几乎每一句话，我都在脑子里那团晃荡的脑浆里过滤过了。

lines.en: And I add “pretty much” to that because I don’t normally include the part with all of the homosexuality.
lines.zh: 我之所以说“几乎”，是因为我平时不会把同性恋那部分加进去。

lines.en: But yes, of course they’re not real enigmas.
lines.zh: 不过对，她们当然不是真正的谜。

lines.en: Not most of them at least.
lines.zh: 至少大多数不是。

lines.en: They’re just girls trying to figure out who they are and where they belong.
lines.zh: 她们只是些正在弄清楚自己是谁、属于哪里的女孩。

lines.en: And I’m just a guy following closely behind them on some wooded trail, waiting for them to get so lost that I can do what I please to them without the fear of being discovered.
lines.zh: 而我只是个在某条林间小道上紧随其后的男人，等着她们迷路到足够深，好让我随心所欲地对她们做点什么，还不必担心被发现。

lines.en: Praise be.
lines.zh: 赞美这一切。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter12
: Anyway, I should probably get going.
lines.zh: : 总之，我大概该走了。

lines.en: : Have an actual fuckin’ “job interview” in the morning.
lines.zh: : 明天早上还真有个“工作面试”。

lines.en: : You? Working?
lines.zh: : 你？要工作？

lines.en: : Crazy, right?
lines.zh: : 疯了，是吧？

lines.en: : Pay is basically shit, but it’s not like I’ve got any experience to my name or whatever.
lines.zh: : 工资基本等于狗屎，不过我名下也没什么工作经验之类的。

lines.en: : Kinda just thankful somebody is willing to even interview me despite that.
lines.zh: : 多少还是有点感激，居然有人愿意在这种条件下还面试我。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to ask what the job is or will you hit me?
lines.zh: : 我能问是什么工作吗，还是你会打我？

lines.en: : Why the fuck would I hit you for askin’ that? It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 我他妈干嘛因为这种问题打你？问吧。

lines.en: : Just some random ass bar. Not really anything to write home about.
lines.zh: : 就是个随便什么破酒吧。没什么好说的。

lines.en: : Stopped in the other day and apparently it’s going under or some shit. Got to talkin’ with the owner and, thought...“You know what? Fuck it.”
lines.zh: : 前几天我顺路进去，好像那店快倒闭了什么的。跟老板聊了聊，然后就想……“管他妈的。”

lines.en: : So...here’s hopin’ I don’t fuckin' ruin everything tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 所以……只希望明天别把事情全搞砸了。

lines.en: : It really is a small world.
lines.zh: : 这世界真小。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter11
: You know it.
lines.zh: : 可不是嘛。

lines.en: : Have fun with your fuckin’ giant orgy or whatever. Make sure you wear a rubber when it’s my daughter’s turn.
lines.zh: : 好好享受你那场他妈的大型群交什么的吧。轮到我女儿的时候记得戴套。

lines.en: : You are such a horrible mother.
lines.zh: : 你可真是个糟糕的母亲。

lines.en: : And you’re a fuckin’ horrible teacher, so I don’t wanna hear it.
lines.zh: : 你他妈是个糟糕的老师，所以你少来这套。

lines.en: : I’ll catch you later.
lines.zh: : 回头见。

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Goodnight, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Yuki。

lines.en: scene nightsky
I slide my phone (Which is now on the brink of death) out of my pocket and quickly punch in the name of our hotel so I can get an idea of where to go in order to get back.
lines.zh: 我把手机（现在已经快没电了）从口袋里掏出来，赶紧输入我们酒店的名字，好知道该往哪儿走才能回去。

lines.en: I’m able to do it seconds before the phone breathes its last electrical breath and find myself walking back amidst one of the quietest winter nights I’ve ever experienced moments later.
lines.zh: 就在手机吐出最后一口电子气的几秒前，我查到了路线，片刻之后便走在我经历过的最安静的冬夜里往回赶。

lines.en: And to think that, just hours ago, things were so loud that I wasn’t sure if I’d ever be able to hear again.
lines.zh: 想想就在几个小时前，一切都吵得让我怀疑自己还能不能再听见声音。

lines.en: I head back toward the origin of sound regardless.
lines.zh: 我还是朝着声音的源头走去。

lines.en: For silence can be nice at times, but painful when you remember everything that needs to be missing in order to achieve it.
lines.zh: 因为安静有时很美好，可当你想起为了得到这份安静需要失去多少东西时，它就变得痛苦了。

lines.en: scene black
scene likemotherlikedaughter13
: Ooooooh, so you were out {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦————原来你在{i}这儿{/i}啊。

lines.en: : And to think that everyone assumed you’d just gone to sleep early.
lines.zh: : 大家还都以为你只是早早睡了呢。

lines.en: : Weren’t you two in your pajamas...recently?
lines.zh: : 你们俩……不是刚换上睡衣了吗？

lines.en: I still have no idea how long it’s been that I’ve been out here as I didn’t even think about checking the time on my phone when I opened my GPS app.
lines.zh: 我还是不知道自己在外面待了多久——打开导航的时候，我压根没想起要看一眼手机上的时间。

lines.en: : A few of us couldn’t sleep, so...we all decided to go for a walk.
lines.zh: : 我们几个睡不着，所以……大家决定出来走走。

lines.en: : All? There are only two of you.
lines.zh: : 大家？可只有你们两个啊。

lines.en: : Otoha and Rin are on their way to the convenience store together to see if they sell Pokemon cards.
lines.zh: : Otoha 和 Rin 正一起去便利店，看看那儿卖不卖宝可梦卡牌。

lines.en: : That is both adorable and slightly depressing at the same time.
lines.zh: : 这既可爱，又同时让人有点沮丧。

lines.en: : Depressing because Otoha is a creature who is immune to romance and Rin is falling deeper into unrequited love with each passing moment?
lines.zh: : 沮丧是因为 Otoha 是个对恋爱免疫的生物，而 Rin 正一分一秒地陷进单恋里越陷越深？

lines.en: : I meant depressing because they’re too old to be playing with cards, but yes. That too.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是沮丧是因为她们已经大到不该玩卡牌了，不过，你说的也算。

lines.en: : I...don’t think they’re too old for that...
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得她们大到不能玩了……

lines.en: : It’s actually...a really common hobby for girls our age.
lines.zh: : 其实……这对我们这个年纪的女生来说是挺常见的爱好。

lines.en: : Futaba has sex dreams about Mr. Mime. True story.
lines.zh: : Futaba 会做关于魔墙人偶的春梦。真事。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter14
: I do not! You’re the one who has dreams like that! Stop making me out to be the weird one!
lines.zh: : 我才没有！做那种梦的是你！别把我说成那个奇怪的人！

lines.en: : Oh, please. It was {i}one{/i} dream. That hardly makes me weird.
lines.zh: : 拜托，就做过{i}一{/i}次梦而已。这可算不上奇怪。

lines.en: : I have no idea who this Mr. Mime person is, but I’m interested in hearing about this dream.
lines.zh: : 我不知道这个魔墙人偶是谁，不过我很有兴趣听听这个梦。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter15
: You really shouldn’t be. It’s...quite disturbing.
lines.zh: : 你真的不该有兴趣。那……相当令人不安。

lines.en: : I have no problem explaining the dream to you in vivid detail, but I would like something in return.
lines.zh: : 我倒是不介意给你绘声绘色地讲讲那个梦，不过我想要点回报。

lines.en: : And do you know what you would want?
lines.zh: : 那你知道自己想要什么吗？

lines.en: : Yes. I want to see your room.
lines.zh: : 知道。我想看看你的房间。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter16
: Wait, Nodoka. What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 等等，Nodoka。你在干什么？

lines.en: : I want to see if it’s true.
lines.zh: : 我想看看那是不是真的。

lines.en: : See if what’s true?
lines.zh: : 看看什么是不是真的？

lines.en: : She’s just...making things up. She does that because...she’s an experienced writer and-
lines.zh: : 她只是……在瞎编。她会这样是因为……她是个经验丰富的作家，而且——

lines.en: : More specifically, I want to see what you and my dear friend here would {i}get up{/i} to in said room assuming that I, Nodoka Nagasawa, was not present at all.
lines.zh: : 更准确地说，我想看看，假如我 Nodoka Nagasawa 完全不在场，你和我这位亲爱的朋友在那个房间里会{i}搞出{/i}些什么。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter14
: Nodoka! Why?!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！为什么啊？！

lines.en: : Futaba, my sweet girl. My sweet, sweet girl. My sweet, beautiful girl with gigantic breasts.
lines.zh: : Futaba，我甜美的姑娘。我甜美又甜美的姑娘。我甜美、美丽、还长着巨乳的姑娘。

lines.en: : Do you not understand why I struggle to believe the news of your apparent...experiments with our dear teacher?
lines.zh: : 你难道不明白，为什么我很难相信你跟我们亲爱的老师之间那些……实验的传闻吗？

lines.en: : It was just the other day that we were frolicking through a field of flowers, holding hands and-
lines.zh: : 就在前几天，我们还手牵着手在花田里嬉戏——

lines.en: : Even if it wasn’t true, why would you just bring it up like that?!
lines.zh: : 就算不是真的，你干嘛就这么直接说出来啊？！

lines.en: : Because it’s funny {i}and{/i} sexual and those are two of my most important character traits.
lines.zh: : 因为这又好笑{i}又{/i}色情，而这两点正是我最重要的性格特质。

lines.en: : So either it’s not true and we all have a laugh about it, or it {i}is{/i} true and I get to watch my teacher copulate with my best friend. Win win.
lines.zh: : 所以要么不是真的，我们大家一起笑笑；要么{i}是{/i}真的，我就能看我的老师和我最好的朋友交配。双赢。

lines.en: : Futaba...did you tell Nodoka about us?
lines.zh: : Futaba……你把我们的事告诉 Nodoka 了？

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter17
: I...may have said...some things.
lines.zh: : 我……可能说过……一些事情。

lines.en: : But I had no idea she was going to immediately blurt them out to you.
lines.zh: : 但我不知道她会立刻就跟你全抖出来。

lines.en: : I have only known about this for ten whole minutes, but they have been ten of the most exciting minutes of my life if any of it is true.
lines.zh: : 我才知道整整十分钟，但如果这些都是真的，那这十分钟是我这辈子最刺激的十分钟。

lines.en: : I do acknowledge that this may still be some elaborate ploy to toy with me, but I am the official dorm wars knowledge champion until further notice, so I’m kind of a big deal.
lines.zh: : 我也承认这可能只是个拿来耍我的精心圈套，不过在另行通知之前，我可是宿舍大战官方的知识冠军，所以我也算个人物。

lines.en: : Not really one to be so easily {i}tricked{/i}, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我可不是那么好{i}骗{/i}的。

lines.en: : You’re not going to say anything about this to anyone else, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会把这事告诉别人吧？

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter18
: Sensei, I’m going to let you in on a little secret.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我告诉你一个小秘密。

lines.en: : I kind of love the girl sitting next to me right now. And I would never do anything that I believe would even come close to hurting her.
lines.zh: : 我其实挺爱现在坐在我身边这个姑娘的。我绝不会做任何我觉得哪怕有一点点可能伤害到她的事。

lines.en: : And, should I happen to hurt her accidentally, I would carve out my insides with a wakizashi.
lines.zh: : 而万一我不小心伤到了她，我会用一把胁差把自己的内脏挖出来。

lines.en: : So, no. I’m not going to tell anyone else.
lines.zh: : 所以，不会。我不会告诉任何人。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter19
: Besides, this isn’t something I’d believe without seeing with my own eyes.
lines.zh: : 再说，这种事我不亲眼看到是不会信的。

lines.en: : Futaba is a delicate flower who will not do anything sexual until she is married, and I am sure this is all just a big, poorly executed prank.
lines.zh: : Futaba 是一朵纤弱的花，结婚前绝不会做任何色色的事，我敢肯定这整件事只是个拙劣的大恶作剧。

lines.en: : Also, the girls in my room were so loud that it made reading near impossible. And if your room is any quieter, I’d like to utilize it for some good ole word absorption.
lines.zh: : 另外，我房间里那群女生吵得我根本看不进去书。要是你房间安静点，我想借来好好吸收一下文字。

lines.en: : And your thoughts on this, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 那你怎么想，Futaba？

lines.en: : I think that she should stop calling reading “word absorption.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得她该别再把看书叫成“吸收文字”了。

lines.en: : You know what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 你知道我问的不是这个。

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter20
: I...am a little curious about your room.
lines.zh: : 我……对你的房间是有点好奇。

lines.en: : And going there doesn’t automatically mean that...you know.
lines.zh: : 而且去那儿也不代表就一定会……你知道的。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you mean by that, Futaba. You and I have never done anything sexual before. Why would you lie about this to Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么，Futaba。你和我从来没做过任何色色的事。你为什么要对 Nodoka 撒这种谎？

lines.en: scene likemotherlikedaughter21
: H-Hey! Now that she already knows, there’s really no point in-
lines.zh: : 喂、喂！她都已经知道了，再这样真的没意义——

lines.en: : In fact, while I’m at it, I’ve never done anything sexual with anyone ever.
lines.zh: : 而且话说回来，我从来没跟任何人做过任何色色的事。

lines.en: : I’m a total virgin who’s never even seen boobs before.
lines.zh: : 我是个彻头彻尾的处男，连女孩子的胸都没见过。

lines.en: : Now...if only there were girls around who’d be willing to show me them...
lines.zh: : 现在……要是有姑娘愿意给我看看就好了……

lines.en: : Oh dear. Perhaps we {i}could{/i} find a janitor’s closet somewhere in the hotel...
lines.zh: : 哎呀。也许我们{i}可以{/i}在酒店里找个清洁工的储物间……

lines.en: : No! We’re going to Sensei’s room now before anyone else hears us talking about this!
lines.zh: : 不行！趁还没别人听见我们说这些，现在就去 Sensei 的房间！

lines.en: scene black
Futaba quickly stands up and grabs Nodoka by the wrist, dragging her up as well.
lines.zh: Futaba 迅速站起身，一把抓住 Nodoka 的手腕，把她也拽了起来。

lines.en: She must already know my room number as she immediately begins to lead the way there.
lines.zh: 她一定已经知道我的房间号，因为她立刻就带头往那边走。

lines.en: Nodoka looks back every few seconds to wink at me and...I really can’t tell if it’s because of the janitor’s closet thing, if she believes what I’ve done with Futaba, or if she {i}doesn’t{/i} believe anything at all.
lines.zh: Nodoka 每隔几秒就回头朝我眨个眼，而我……真说不清那是因为储物间那件事，还是她信了我跟 Futaba 的事，还是她什么都{i}不{/i}信。

lines.en: It could really mean anything with that girl.
lines.zh: 跟那个姑娘有关的事，真的什么都有可能。

lines.en: Eventually, we make it to my door and I grab the key out of my pocket, insanely curious about whatever is about to happen.
lines.zh: 最后我们到了我的房门口，我从口袋里掏出房卡，对接下来要发生的一切好奇得要命。

lines.en: if futaba_lust >= 15 and nodokadorm5 == True:

jump futabalust15

Unfortunately, nothing exciting happens at all.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，什么刺激的事都没发生。

lines.en: The two of them take a look around, say some things about how nice the furniture is, and then remove books from their respective bags and start reading them, paying no mind to me at all.
lines.zh: 她俩四处看了看，说了几句家具真不错之类的话，然后从各自的包里掏出书来看，完全把我晾在一边。

lines.en: Things have quieted down, and I’m reminded once more of how much I hate silence sometimes.
lines.zh: 周围安静下来，我再一次想起自己有时候有多讨厌安静。

lines.en: And how I wish to fill the room with new, exciting noises.
lines.zh: 以及我多想让这个房间充满新鲜的、令人兴奋的声音。

lines.en: Noises that could be heard all the way down the hall.
lines.zh: 那种能一直传到走廊另一头的声音。

lines.en: I lie on the bed and close my eyes, not minding whether or not I fall asleep with the local bookworms present.
lines.zh: 我躺在床上闭上眼睛，并不介意在这两个小书虫面前睡着。

lines.en: And that is exactly what happens.
lines.zh: 然后我就真的睡着了。
